propositions: MCP_HMAC_SIGNING_KEY environment variable and /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key SSM parameter have a producer (terraform) and transport (user_data.sh, fetch-secrets.sh) but zero runtime consumers in application code

The secret's documented purpose (verdict signing) was superseded by ADR 0049, which replaced symmetric HMAC with asymmetric Ed25519 operation certificates, and no code path reads the HMAC secret anymore
Operators are obligated to provision, KMS-store, and rotate this live-looking but unused secret, creating pure toil with zero security effect and audit confusion
Removal requires atomicity across producer (ssm.tf) and both transports (user_data.sh and fetch-secrets.sh) to avoid boot-time failures if script references remain after the SSM slot is destroyed
Six tracked files must be modified to remove the orphan: ssm.tf, user_data.sh, fetch-secrets.sh, docs/adr/0012-iac-foundations.md, docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md, and infra/runbooks/provision-restore.md
Rollback cost is minimal (one-line terraform re-add plus parameter repopulation) since no supported deployment target consumes the secret
